ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a schematic diagram of the variation of day length and night length with months in a certain place within one year. The horizontal axis is months 1-12; the upper half represents day length (hours), and the lower half represents night length (hours). The figure shows that around the middle of the year there is a continuous period of 24-hour day length, that is, polar day; at the beginning and end of the year there is a continuous period of 24-hour night length, that is, polar night. Reasoning: This place has polar day in the Northern Hemisphere summer and polar night in winter, which conforms to the characteristics of the annual variation of day and night at the North Pole. Therefore, this place can be judged to be the North Pole. At the North Pole, any horizontal direction on the ground points south, so the four directions of the GPS map screen, top, bottom, left, and right, all point south.

raw_record.standard_answer: Up, down, left, and right are all south

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a yearly day/night length graph by month, with a long interval of 24-hour daylight around the middle of the year and a long interval of 24-hour night around the beginning/end of the year. Use the question text to know the required output is the GPS screen directions at that place. Infer from the image that the place is the North Pole, because its polar day is in the Northern Hemisphere summer half-year. Then use the rule that at the North Pole all directions on the ground point south. Therefore the GPS screen’s up, down, left, and right all point south.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是某地一年内昼长和夜长随月份变化的示意图，横轴为1—12月，上半部分表示昼长（小时），下半部分表示夜长（小时）。图上显示年中前后有一段连续的24小时昼长，即极昼；年初和年末有一段连续的24小时夜长，即极夜。推理：该地在北半球夏季出现极昼、冬季出现极夜，符合北极点的昼夜年变化特征。因此该地可判断为北极点。在北极点处，地面上任意水平方向都指向南方，所以GPS地图屏幕的上、下、左、右四个方向都指向南。
